title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft Department / Cost Center → FinancialOrg

source_objects.description: Department table: SETID, DEPTID, EFFDT, DESCR, MANAGER_ID, BUDGET_DEPTID, COMPANY, EFF_STATUS. Effective-dated.
Department hierarchy: parent-child relationships for roll-up reporting. Tree name varies by institution (commonly 'DEPT_SECURITY' or institution-specific).
Company / legal entity: COMPANY, DESCR. Top-level organizational entity (campus, school, affiliated entity).

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Effective-dated — use latest active row.
Resolve parent department from the tree.
The legal entity / campus this department belongs to.
Resolve to name. Department head / budget owner.

attribute_mappings.source: PS_DEPT_TBL.BUDGET_DEPTID or derived from default fund on the dept
attribute_mappings.transformation: Some institutions configure a default fund type per department for budgeting.

notes: PS departments are effective-dated — always join on max EFFDT ≤ target date. The tree structure (PSTREENODE) is how PS does hierarchies; the tree name and SETID must be known to query it correctly. BUDGET_DEPTID may differ from DEPTID if the institution uses a separate budget department structure.
